verdict.rationale: Gumroad's own copy says a creator can upload a file, set a price and start selling, and every product gets a canonical short URL that can be shared. Community reactions corroborate that this setup is simple and fast. missing for 10: explicit first-party docs of the dashboard product-creation flow with no code, hands-on evidence of the time from signup to first sale.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create a shareable payment link from the dashboard with no code and start selling immediately

citations.quote: I upload a file, set a price, and I can start selling on the internet.
every product has a canonical short URL
the simplest way to sell digital goods
